format: 16:9 cinematic commercial, 30 s, 24 fps, anamorphic look; deliver web (-14 LUFS) and broadcast (-24 LKFS) masters
status: storyboard, awaiting decisions before any generation
idea: The weight of managing wealth across many platforms (logins, accounts, tabs, statements) collapses into one calm place: LibertyStone, where shares, ETFs and crypto live together.

brand.name: LibertyStone (one word, camel case)
brand.palette_from_logo: near-black navy ground about #0D1524, soft off-white about #E8ECF2; brief calls for a muted teal accent (confirm exact hex)
brand.font: geometric sans in the wordmark (confirm the brand typeface for the dashboard and any on-screen line)

issues_in_prior_attempt: Screens are AI-generated and render as gibberish (monitors, the 'libertystone ONE' card, the dashboard). AI cannot draw real UI.
The hero balance '$59.00' is meaningless and the dashboard does not show the actual product.
The whole selling point (shares, ETFs and crypto in ONE place) never lands: no clear product, no words, no text.
With no VO and no on-screen text, a viewer cannot tell what LibertyStone is or that crypto sits beside shares and ETFs.
fixes: Frustration shots keep every screen blurred, angled or partial so nothing reads as gibberish; the overload comes from quantity and her reaction, not legible screens.

The solution shot uses a REAL designed dashboard mockup (built in HTML, captured, composited onto the laptop screen), not a generation. It shows one balance and a single holdings list that mixes Shares, ETFs and Crypto, so the USP is visible.
Replace '$59.00' with a realistic portfolio balance and a short holdings breakdown.
Lock the woman's face with a character reference image so she holds across clips.
End on the supplied LibertyStone logo animation plus one short line that states the USP, and a small risk line.
Recommend at least an on-screen tagline (and optionally one calm VO line); pure silence will not convey the crypto-alongside-shares message.

shots.name: order
shots.desc: Confident Australian woman, late 50s, at a home study desk at dusk, one printed portfolio summary, a pen, composed and decisive. Slow push-in, warm lamp, faint skyline. Establish premium and calm.

shots.name: overload
shots.desc: The desk multiplies around her: a second laptop, a phone lighting up, stacked folders, a second monitor, a printed spreadsheet, an accountant's letter. Camera slowly orbits as it clutters; posture tightens; sound busies. All screens turned away or out of focus, no readable text.

shots.name: friction
shots.desc: Close on her hands switching phone, laptop, paper. Abstracted login field, password dots, a loading spinner, a 2FA code, a crowded inbox, getting faster and colder. Hold on her face, a quiet exhale. Clean dark negative space on the left third.

shots.name: one-place
shots.mode: generate the plate + composite the real dashboard mockup
shots.desc: Hard reset to black; clutter dissolves. One sleek laptop on a clean dark desk, screen showing the LibertyStone dark dashboard: one clear portfolio balance and a calm holdings list visibly mixing Shares, ETFs and Crypto. Slow dolly in, warm light returns, she leans back. Sound resolves to a single piano note.

shots.name: logo
shots.on_screen: LibertyStone mark and wordmark; one tagline line; small risk line
shots.desc: Black frame resolves into the LibertyStone logo animation. One soft chime. Tagline states the USP (for example: 'Shares, ETFs and crypto. One place.'). Small compliance line beneath.

dashboard_mockup.why: The product must be shown for real; a generated UI is gibberish. I build it in HTML in the brand's dark navy and white with the teal accent, render it at the laptop screen's pixel size, and corner-pin it onto the generated laptop plate.
dashboard_mockup.content: Header: LibertyStone mark + 'Portfolio'. One large total balance. A single holdings list with a type tag on each row: Shares, ETF, Crypto (tasteful placeholder names, no real tickers), each with a small value and a calm up/down figure. A quiet sparkline. Dark mode, lots of negative space.
dashboard_mockup.confirm: the balance figure, that crypto should sit in the same list as shares and ETFs (the whole point), and placeholder holdings rather than real company names.

sound: Quiet solo piano and room tone, layered with notification chimes and keyboard clicks through the overload, resolving to a single held piano note and one soft chime on the logo. VO optional.
build_plan: 1. Character reference image of the woman (nano-banana-pro, 16:9 still) to lock her face.
2. Generate the frustration clips at 480p drafts (Seedance 2.5): order, overload orbit, 2-3 friction inserts, and the clean solution plate (laptop screen off).
3. Design the LibertyStone dashboard in HTML, render it, composite onto the laptop screen in the solution shot.
4. End card from the supplied logo animation; add the tagline and risk line.
5. Sound design (piano bed, layered chimes/clicks, resolve); optional VO.
6. Stitch, grade to the cinematic navy look, verify (strip, loudness, yuv420p), send a review cut; 1080p finals once approved.
cost_estimate: Character image about 36 credits; 6 to 8 draft clips at 480p about 1800 to 2400 list credits; dashboard and end card are free; exact price quoted before the batch.
decisions_needed: USP delivery: on-screen tagline only, or add one short calm VO line? (Recommend at least the tagline; the message needs words.)
Dashboard: confirm crypto shows in the same list as shares and ETFs, the balance figure, and placeholder holdings (no real tickers).
Brand: do you have a clean logo file, brand colours (exact hex) and the brand font? Otherwise I match from the animation.
Compliance: is this Australian (AFSL needed)? What risk wording must appear (crypto and investing carry risk)?
